ptolemy.claim: One versus more-than-one marriage and single versus two-or-more offspring; count conditions retain their source qualifications.

rhetorius.claim: Expresses difficulty with numerical claims for siblings, wives and children, recommends many, but immediately says he will still attempt as much as possible. Holden separately quotes a Byzantine epitomator.

comparisons.project_implication: Do not say either source supplies calibrated exact counts; do not quote Rhetorius's hesitation as abandonment of the attempt.

ptolemy.claim: Moon/Jupiter/Venus give children; Sun/Mars/Saturn limit; Mercury common; Anonymous glosses sect as outcome groups.

rhetorius.claim: Sibling enquiry uses Jupiter/Venus/Mercury as favourable qualified significators; conditional Saturn/Mars/Moon branches are adverse.

comparisons.project_implication: A global reusable benefic/sect grouping would erase source-topical role differences. No independent predictive corroboration.

ptolemy.claim: Names Leo and Virgo as examples of sterile places in offspring enquiry; not an asserted exhaustive list.

rhetorius.claim: Names Gemini/Leo/Virgo/Capricorn/Sagittarius in a third-sign sibling enquiry.

comparisons.project_implication: Keep each list and its scope; do not augment Ptolemy's examples silently or claim all five apply to its offspring calculation.
